_comment: v2 architecture shared by all stages: own 48k BPE tokenizer, 1024 wide x 32 layers (24 GDN + 8 attention, 3:1), GQA 16q/4kv, QK-norm, native GDN weights (FLA kernel on CUDA, PyTorch elsewhere) → ~443M decoder params. Context: 1024 here; the v2 pretrain configs use 2048 and configs/a100_longctx_v2.json extends to 16k. v1 values are pinned in configs/a100_pretrain.json.
